historical_references.reference: Mirfiq was an important port city on the Mediterranean coast of Tunisia, known for its production of salt, fish, and textiles. It was a major center of Islamic scholarship during the Fatimid period (909-1171 CE). The city was a major cultural hub, with many renowned scholars, poets, and artists residing there.

Mirfiq was also a significant naval power during the Aghlabid period (800-909 CE), with a well-equipped fleet used to defend the coast and protect trade routes. The city's strategic location made it an essential outpost for controlling the Mediterranean sea lanes.

Twitch streamers and YouTube Gaming creators with the name Mirfiq often stream games like Fortnite, Minecraft, and Call of Duty.
